terms.gloss: deep (the same word means high: seen from above downwards, deep)
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 4.4.14: quom ex altō puteō sūrsum ad summum ēscenderis (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: deep, bottomless, vast; as a noun, profundum, the depth, the deep
evidence: Cic. Planc. 15: mare profundum et immēnsum (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: quom ex altō puteō sūrsum ad summum ēscenderis
phrases.english: when you have climbed from the deep well up to the top

phrases.latin: eadem fretō lītorī campīs faciēs, neque discernī poterant incerta ab solidīs, brevia ā profundīs
phrases.english: sea, shore and fields all looked alike, and unsure ground could not be told from firm, nor shallows from deep water

sources: Lewis & Short: altus
